blocks.title: WHO IV fluid regimen for children with severe dehydration due to diarrhoea:

items.text: Total 100 mL/kg of Ringer's lactate (preferred) or normal saline if unavailable.
Infants younger than 12 months: 30 mL/kg over 1 hour, then 70 mL/kg over 5 hours.
Children aged 12 months and older: 30 mL/kg over 30 minutes, then 70 mL/kg over 2.5 hours.

blocks.text: Reassess frequently, monitor perfusion and urine output, and give ORS as soon as the child can drink.
